name: Sekisan Partners
description: Sekisan Partners — a landing theme for an independent building cost consultancy. A fixed 84 px solid ink-green rail frames every page; the home page opens on one full-bleed high-key photograph of a marked-up cost plan with the headline in its empty left part, a single outline request button, a scroll cue and six section dots. It continues with a white panel of hairline rows over a parallax portrait, numbered caps index rows with blue and teal numerals, a full-width photograph with five stages, three square cards with one coral tile, a full-width fee table, a parallax band with an overlapping case panel, a hairline list of the people and a dark closing block with a coral first letter. Square 3 px buttons with an arrow, one repeated call to action. Albert Sans for headings, Onest for reading. Sample content in English first; the other four languages follow. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
